segments.text: So a neural network is a network of artificial neurons.
It tries to simulate the human brain, and
and the neural network has many layers of neurons.
And the first layer will receive the input like image, video, sound, text or anything,
then the input data will go through all network layers,
and the output of one layer will be fed into the next layer.
So there are many millions, there are millions of parameters in neural networks.
And neural networks can be used to recognize things.
For example, like networks can be used to recognize that there is a dog
or there is a cat in the image.
And so there is a need to have big data in training neural networks.
Just like humans, just like us, actually, humans take advantage of big data.
Imagine a person perceive like 30 frames, 30 images per second,
that means 1800 images per minute, and over 600 million images per year.
So that's why we should give neural networks a similar opportunity
to have the big data for training.
Yeah, so there are many, many applications of neural networks
like facial recognition and driverless cars.
So for example, like the faces detected by the smartphone's camera
will be recognized by the neural network.
Or in another application, the driverless car is equipped with all the
multiple cameras which try to recognize the surrounding environment.
So the autonomous cars are able to recognize other vehicles,
recognize traffic sign, stop sign, and from the recognition the car
can change the speed automatically, even does the brake
to avoid any potential accidents.
So neural networks were invented long time ago.
Then it went through the long long hibernation due to all the
lightweight models because of the computational costs.
So recently, it's grows again, thanks to advanced computational
resources like graphical processing unit, it's called GPU.
So that's why now we see the prospering of neural networks.
